entry.title: Compositional Generalization Limits in Connectionist Architectures Versus Symbolic Program Induction
entry.summary:
Systematicity and productivity require algebraic role-filler independence that standard autoregressive sequence models approximate only within training convex hulls. Comparing minimum-description-length (MDL) Bayesian program learners against transformer state-tracking circuits reveals a sharp phase transition in out-of-distribution recursive depth at $d \ge 7$.

Source: Bilim Akademisi Sarkaç / Cognitive Systems · Tags: #cognitive-science #ai-ethics #logic
